purpose: Define and fail-closed adjudicate the smallest two-scalar covariant EFT template found here that can represent an E/RAR-like local base and a B-gated finite-range additive channel while coupling matter and photons through one physical metric; do not claim health, novelty, or empirical support.

role_mapping.N_additive_channel: massive chi response with Z_chi(u)=B(u)^(-2) and range ell_chi=1/m_chi

conventions_and_dimensions.covariant_derivative: Levi-Civita connection of Einstein metric g_mu_nu

action_family.action: S=int d4x sqrt(-g)[M_Pl^2*R/2 + M_phi^4*P(y) + Z_chi(u)*(X_chi - m_chi^2*chi^2/2) - V_phi(phi)] + S_m[psi,g_tilde]

gate_and_range.high_invariant_behavior: u->infinity implies B->0 and Z_chi->infinity, suppressing the sourced chi amplitude by 1/Z_chi=B^2 in the locally constant-background estimate while leaving ell_chi=1/m_chi fixed
gate_and_range.low_invariant_behavior: u->0 implies B->1 and Z_chi->1 for the entire chi quadratic sector
gate_and_range.nonconstant_background_obligation: Gradients of Z_chi and kinetic/mass mixing with the phi background must be retained; the locally constant Green-function estimate is not valid until their size is bounded on every tested background.

local_base_target_branch.quasistatic_equation: div[P_y(-|grad(phi)|^2/(2*M_phi^4))*grad(phi)]=alpha_phi*rho_b/M_Pl when chi and disformal terms are disabled
local_base_target_branch.functional_requirement: P_y on the spacelike quasistatic branch must reproduce the declared nu_E mapping under the frozen source symmetry/solver contract, remain single-valued, and extend to a healthy timelike cosmological branch

finite_range_channel.slow_background_green_function: chi(r) proportional to B(u)^2*exp(-m_chi*r)/r when u is locally constant
finite_range_channel.additive_matter_acceleration: g_N_channel=alpha_chi*|grad(chi)|/M_Pl plus the universal disformal geodesic contribution

term_provenance_ledger.basis: massive scalar finite-range response with one environment-dependent normalization multiplying its full quadratic sector
combination of invariant screening and finite-range scalar response flagged for literature review
assembled target architecture only; no authoritative novelty search or claim

field_equations_and_symbolic_contract.metric_equation: M_Pl^2*G_mu_nu=T_phi_mu_nu+T_chi_mu_nu+T_m_E_mu_nu, with every X_phi dependence of Z_chi multiplying the full bracket [X_chi-m_chi^2*chi^2/2] and every conformal/disformal matter variation included by functional differentiation

matter_source_functionals.Q_phi: -(1/sqrt(-g))*delta(S_m)/delta(phi), including derivative terms generated by the disformal metric

field_equations_and_symbolic_contract.field_stress_definition: T_fields_mu_nu=-(2/sqrt(-g))*delta(S_phi+S_chi)/delta(g^mu_nu); the Z_chi,u metric variation multiplying [X_chi-m_chi^2*chi^2/2] is mandatory and may not be dropped
symbolic_derivation_requirements: derive Euler-Lagrange equations from the exact action before substituting a background
retain boundary terms until the variational boundary conditions are declared
expand the full two-field principal symbol including Z_chi,u, Z_chi,uu, gradients of Z_chi, and phi-background mixing
derive Einstein-frame matter sources from the one physical metric rather than inserting rho by hand
verify the diffeomorphism Noether identity symbolically off shell
derive weak-field equations before imposing spherical symmetry
derive FLRW background and quadratic perturbation actions from the same parameter set

degrees_of_freedom.condition: The count holds only if the two-field kinetic Hessian is nondegenerate, the physical-metric transformation is invertible, no extra higher-derivative matter mode appears below the EFT cutoff, and all constraints close.

conservation_identity.physical_frame: g_tilde_nabla_mu(T_tilde_m^mu_nu)=0 when matter equations hold because all matter and photons couple to the same g_tilde_mu_nu
conservation_identity.total_identity: nabla_mu[T_m_E^mu_nu+T_phi^mu_nu+T_chi^mu_nu]=0 after the two scalar equations and metric equation hold

static_conformal_limit.lensing_sum: Phi+Psi=Phi_E+Psi_E; the leading conformal scalar contribution cancels

weak_field_matter_and_lensing.disformal_effect: For spatial phi gradients, d_phi*nabla_i(phi)*nabla_j(phi)/M_phi^4 adds an anisotropic photon/matter metric contribution that must be projected through the full lens equation; it is not an independent photon multiplier.
weak_field_matter_and_lensing.lensing_gate: A viable completion must predict Phi, Psi, slip, convergence, and shear from one parameter set and one g_tilde, with no lensing-only coefficient.

health_and_consistency_gates.requirement: Every term is a scalar density of mass dimension four and one universal physical metric is used.
Machine-derive full metric/scalar equations, principal symbol, Hamiltonian constraints, and off-shell Noether identity.
All eigenvalues of the two-scalar time-kinetic matrix from the quadratic action are positive below the EFT cutoff; P_y>0, P_y+2*y*P_yy>0, and Z_chi>0 are necessary but not sufficient.

The full coupled principal symbol, including gradients of Z_chi and phi-background kinetic/mass mixing, has one common timelike covector, real positive scalar sound-speed squared eigenvalues, and a well-posed Cauchy surface on Solar, galaxy, group, cluster, and FLRW backgrounds.
Strong-coupling scale exceeds every frozen spatial, temporal, source, gradient-of-Z_chi, and background-mixing scale used in a test and remains above the disformal scale.
EH gives c_T(g)=1; on homogeneous phi(t), c_GW/c_gamma=[1-d_phi*dot(phi)^2/M_phi^4]^(-1/2), the physical metric remains Lorentzian, and |c_GW/c_gamma-1|<=1e-15 on the late-time background.

The same P, B, couplings, and boundary conditions yield |gamma_PPN-1|<=2.3e-5, suppress the scalar fifth-force ratio below the frozen Solar-System bound, and avoid preferred-frame/disformal anomalies without a Solar-only coefficient.

Solve 3*M_Pl^2*H^2=rho_m+rho_r+rho_phi+rho_chi and both scalar background equations; demonstrate stable perturbations, acceptable early scalar fraction, late expansion, G_eff evolution, and no unintended chi activation from timelike X_phi.
Derive dynamics and lensing from the same g_tilde and parameters; conformal cancellation or a disformal health failure cannot be repaired with a photon-only factor.

Derive, rather than fit after target access, a globally healthy P branch and show that the chi Green function has fixed range 1/m_chi, amplitude gate B^2, and controlled gradient-of-Z_chi corrections outside the locally constant and spherical limits.

parameter_domains.d_phi: finite real subject to invertibility, GW, hyperbolicity, and cutoff gates
parameter_domains.P_function: single frozen differentiable function on all tested spacelike and timelike y
parameter_domains.V_phi: single frozen potential bounded sufficiently for every tested background

exact_parameter_and_limit_gates.zero_coupling_limit: alpha_phi=alpha_chi=d_phi=0 makes g_tilde=g and removes scalar forces from matter/photon geodesics
exact_parameter_and_limit_gates.gr_limit: alpha_phi=alpha_chi=d_phi=0, phi and chi constant at zero-stress extrema, P(0)=0, and V_phi=0 gives Einstein gravity plus minimally coupled matter
exact_parameter_and_limit_gates.high_acceleration_limit: u->infinity requires B->0, Z_chi->infinity, locally constant-background chi source amplitude 1/Z_chi=B^2->0 at fixed range 1/m_chi, |g_chi/g_N|->0 after gradient-of-Z_chi corrections are bounded, and the frozen P branch must also enforce |g_phi/g_N|->0
exact_parameter_and_limit_gates.low_invariant_limit: u->0 gives B->1 and a canonical-normalized full chi quadratic sector with range 1/m_chi
exact_parameter_and_limit_gates.zero_finite_channel_limit: alpha_chi->0 or m_chi->infinity removes the N channel without changing the phi local-base action
exact_parameter_and_limit_gates.zero_local_base_limit: alpha_phi->0 removes the direct phi conformal force but does not by itself remove derivative gate background effects; a valid ablation must also freeze phi at a constant solution
exact_parameter_and_limit_gates.no_disformal_limit: d_phi=0 restores a purely conformal universal metric and therefore the leading weak-field scalar lensing cancellation
exact_parameter_and_limit_gates.promotion_rule: No observational execution may begin until P, V_phi, all parameter values, ell_chi, cutoff, background/branch choice, boundary conditions, and H2-H10 adjudicators are hash-frozen and passed.
